# M3 The Wall (Muro Alto, in the Aurelian march): take HQ 2 (16,12) inside the keep. A ragged outer wall of rock around the town with gates gate1 (16,6) N, gate2 (8,12) W, gate3 (24,12) E; the keep ring around the HQ, one gate (16,15) S. Vehicles must use the gates, foot soldiers climb the rock. Sea y0..1 north with a shoal y2: Drake's BS (hold) shells the coast road y3 and the north gate approach. The Muro river rises in the SW hills and runs north to the sea at x5, bridged on the coast road and the west road. Player funds 2000, start: ART3 ROCK2 RECON2 INF4 MECH2 TANK2 AA1; enemy: INF4 MECH2 TANK3 AA1 ART2 ROCK1 (hold) + BS1. Threat->answer: BS -> day-2 Bomber from the airport + ART/ROCK on the coast (indirect fire hits ships); Com Towers (+defence for Javier) -> ART/ROCK take the towers, which stand just inside the wall; enemy ART/ROCK behind the wall -> RECON spotting, fast capture of gates, MECH over the rock; enemy TANK -> player TANK/ART at the gates; enemy AA -> keep the Bomber away from it (it sits at (18,7)); ground attackers over the wall are INF/MECH only.
